primaryWitnesses.text: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: カナン諸民族の一つ「エブス人」。都市ではない。

primaryWitnesses.text: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: エルサレムを「エブスとも呼ばれる」と明示する。

primaryWitnesses.text: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: 「エブスの住民」として直前に同定された都市名を再使用。

primaryWitnesses.text: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: ユダヤ人の敵対集団「エブス人」を指す。

primaryWitnesses.text: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: 「エブス人オルナン」という出自形容であり、町の直接用例ではない。

primaryWitnesses.text: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: 人物オルナンの出自を表す「エブス人」で、都市名ではない。

primaryWitnesses.text: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: 人物オルナンの出自を表す形容詞で、町の直接用例ではない。
